item.title: Bridge in Grantham named the second most hit in the UK
item.description: A Grantham bridge has been named the second most-struck in the country. New Network Rail figures show Harlaxton Road bridge was hit 18 times in 2024/25, up from 14 the previous year. Only the Watling Street bridge on the A5 in Hinckley saw more collisions.
